_doc: Phase 6.2.3 conformance allowlist. Every color literal in src is scanned and must be ACCOUNTED FOR here or be a token reference. Nothing is silently skipped. Raw 0x color in a product file that is not covered by an authoredData region is a hard failure.

src/SceneView.jsx.reason: Photo-grounded per-building tint/awning/frame DATA, not style tokens. Phase 6.2.2 relocates this into the tier x material registry; allowlisted until then.

exemptGlobs.reason: Debug-mode runtime (?debug=1) — explicitly NOT the product look; Scene-vs-Debug constraint.
Imported only by the Debug runtime.
Test files reference tokens and color bounds, not product style.
UI/CSS chrome — parallel CSS-variable registry, separate axis from the 3D scene tokens.

hexStringDebt._doc: #rrggbb string colors in product files are the canvas-texture / CSS registry (e.g. makeStorefrontSignTexture). Reported loudly as tracked debt; not yet fatal. Migration tracked in COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md.
